We also use third-party cookies – which are cookies from a domain different than the domain of the website you are visiting – for our advertising and marketing efforts. California Consumers

The California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) provides California consumers with the right to opt-out of sales/sharing of their personal information, as well as the right to limit certain uses of sensitive personal information.

With respect to sales and sharing, we offer California consumers the ability to opt-out of the following:

  • Sales/sharing through use of Tracking Technologies on our website; and
  • Other sales/sharing of personal information that do not involve Tracking Technologies.

When we detect an opt-out preference signal, we will opt-you out of sales/sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising as described in the “Our websites” tab of this Privacy Management Hub.

To opt-out of sales/sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising under the CCPA that do not involve Tracking Technologies, please submit a Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information request using this webform. You may also use this webform to submit a request to limit the use of your sensitive personal information.

If you are an existing DIRECTV customer, you may also log into your account to submit a Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information request in our Privacy Preference Center.

You may also submit a request by emailing us at privacypolicy@directv.com.

For more information, please see the California section at Your Privacy Choices.
